notes: HPE's own Phenom search (/us/en/search-results) posts to https://careers.hpe.com/widgets with ddoKey='refineSearch', global=true, clearAll=true, from/size paging, keywords, subsearch, sortBy and selected_fields + all_fields=['city','state','category','type','orgFunction','country']. Facets are applied through selected_fields as {field:[values]} and the response's refineSearch.data.aggregations returns the option lists/counts. Sort labels ('Most Recent', 'Newest to Oldest', 'Title A-Z', ...) are rendered by the UI and travel in the same sortBy field, but sending sortBy='Most Recent' did not reorder the results, so no sort value is declared here.
